about: Stoub Biz Motors LLC specializes in procuring the finest luxury motorcars in the world for our local, regional, and international clients. With over 20 years of experience in the sport, exotic, luxury, and supercar business, we maintain close ties with the top manufacturers and importers. This gives us an edge to secure even the hardest-to-find vehicles at special prices - in both regular and rare editions.

Experience the unmistakable presence of Italian automotive excellence with the 2026 Ferrari 12 Cilindri, finished in the stunning Rosso Imola classic exterior colour with a matching Rosso Ferrari interior.
